subject.title: fix(active-memory): honor abortSignal during recall cleanup retry delays

question: Should recall cancellation be allowed to permanently leave session lifecycle artifacts, or must cleanup continue through a separate bounded/durable mechanism after the recall has settled?
rationale: The patch intentionally trades durable cleanup for prompt return. That is a persistence and retention policy choice, not a mechanical test repair, and the single-follow-up proof does not settle behavior under recurring cancellation.

options.title: Preserve durable cleanup
options.body: Keep the main recall result non-blocking, but move post-cancellation cleanup to an explicit bounded lifecycle owner and prove eventual artifact removal.

options.title: Accept retained artifacts
options.body: Document that cancelled recalls may retain session artifacts and add a bounded reaper or retention policy with repeated-cancellation proof.

options.title: Keep the current shortcut
options.body: Merge the immediate return behavior and accept unbounded retained artifacts as the cancellation contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve durable cleanup
recommendation.body: Keep the main recall result non-blocking, but move post-cancellation cleanup to an explicit bounded lifecycle owner and prove eventual artifact removal.
